schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group non-major dev dependency updates and merge them once CI passes. They don't end up in dist/.
Group GitHub Actions updates. Only non-major ones merge automatically once CI passes.
CI must test on the Node version the action runs on (runs.using in action.yml). Bump both together by hand when GitHub supports a newer runtime.
Runtime dependencies are bundled into dist/, which Renovate can't rebuild. Never auto-merge them.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Runtime dependency:** check out this branch, run `npm ci && npm run build`, and commit the updated `dist/` before merging. CI fails until you do.

packageRules.description: Keep @types/node on the Node version the action runs on (node24 in action.yml).
TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) compiler; typescript-eslint and ncc's loader don't support it yet.
